thread:
jules: Heads-up: during onprem hardening tests we observed repeated outbound calls from the keystore-agent to 169.254.169.254 and transient 5xxs from our keystore-proxy. Looks like identity fetch churn. Anyone seen this pattern before?
anya: which cluster and which agent version?
jules: onprem-west, agent v2.1.3. logs show auth.FetchIdentity invoked on every GetKey. snippet: 
```
[2026-03-23T02:14:02Z] keystore-agent INFO call=GetKey id=aa7c client=svc-ingest
[2026-03-23T02:14:02Z] http GET http://169.254.169.254/meta/identity -> 200
[2026-03-23T02:14:02Z] proxy dial 10.10.8.12:8443 -> 502 Bad Gateway
[2026-03-23T02:14:02Z] trace stack=auth.FetchIdentity->keystore.GetRemoteKey
```
marco: likely caching disabled. check KEYSERVER_AUTH_CACHE_TTL and agent flags.
sara: also note: if many pods call metadata IP frequently, netpols need to prevent lateral metadata access. we should scope egress to only the proxy ip and block 169.254 unless required.
ops-kate: i'm seeing KEYSERVER_AUTH_CACHE_TTL unset in the chart for that cluster (we used a generic bootstrap). will push 15m default and canary.
sec-bot: flagged 201 identity fetches in 20m from namespace priv-onprem-west. potential misconfig. severity=low->medium due to proxy 5xxs.
anya: immediate plan: (1) set cache TTL 15m and rollout canary, (2) add transient rate limit in proxy to avoid 5xx storm, (3) adjust netpols to deny direct metadata IP egress from app pods, only allow keystore-agent to reach metadata if needed.
jules: agree. also request an audit enhancement: include serviceaccount and pod labels in identity fetch audit entries so we can correlate.
marco: code change: agent v2.1.4 will add local in-memory token cache and jittered refresh to avoid thundering herd. will open PR.
ops-kate: PR created to set TTL=15m -> https://git.company/pr/1801 and netpol patch -> https://git.company/pr/1802. canary rolling now.
sara: add a Kibana query for SRE: count by serviceaccount where metadata_hits > 10 in 5m. also add alert for proxy 5xx rate > 1% during rollout.
sec-bot: ticket SEC-2026-330 created; assignees=jules,marco; due=2026-03-25.
jules: after TTL change, canary shows metadata hits drop from 98/5m to 2/5m. proxy errors dropped to baseline.
anya: follow-ups: tighten RBAC so only keystore-agent SA can call the proxy endpoint (netpol+rolebinding), document threat model for metadata-based identity vs mTLS, and add automated test in onboarding to validate KEYSERVER_AUTH_CACHE_TTL presence.
marco: will include migration notes in PR and unit test for jittered refresh.
ops-kate: adding monitor: sum(rate(keystore_identity_fetches[5m])) by (namespace,svc_acc) and alert if > 5.
sara: please add runbook steps to rollback TTL change and how to emergency bind SAs in case of mass 403s.
jules: thanks all, closing once PRs merged and monitors stable for 48h.
